top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four children files were missing vaccinations, one child file was missing a health statement, one child file was missing the permission to have medical treatment, one child was missing start date,and  one child file was missing the address for pick up persons.  During the follow up inspection, children's files were missing immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 10 children were missing special care needs information in their admission paperwork.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.
